reviews.title: Great budget option
reviews.comment: Good fan for the price, decent noise level, airflow is on par for a 120mm fan and is controllable by the motherboard or a fan controller.
reviews.author: Chris walk

reviews.title: Excellent Value!
reviews.comment: I built a new computer for my son as a gift recently and ultimately I was jealous how nice it turned out and wanted to redo my computer as well.  I used Lian Li fans in his but didn't want to spend as much on myself and looked for something similar, which I chose these.  The only thing they lack is the ability to snap them together for daisy chain configuration, not a big deal.  They are quiet, great looking and work great with my motherboard in regards to the RGB and fan speed control.
reviews.author: L8knight

reviews.title: Great for budget or epic builds.
reviews.comment: One thing to consider: the housing of these fans are a bit thicker than I anticipated, still mounts to 120mm just fine but the size of the actual fan is just a smidgen smaller than that of a regular 120mm fan. Ensure you have your fans in PWM mode in bios and the noise level is sooo low. No issues syncing up to my msi mystic light after a simple daisy chain. I can't review product longevity because these are new but I will update as time goes on. I bought three of these and I'm happy.
